我最初是喜欢 Opus 5.5 的。模型更强，价格又降了，这当然值得高兴。我同时: I liked Opus 5.5 at first. A stronger model at a lower price was welcome news. I subscribe to both Claude Pro and ChatGPT Plus and use Claude Code and Codex, so I had reason to hope that competition would eventually benefit users.
但看完自己的消耗记录、AA 的测试，再把罗福莉谈推理降本的帖文与 Anthrop: But after looking at my own usage records and AA's tests, then reading Fuli Luo's post on inference cost reductions alongside Anthropic's capacity expansion and incident reports, I have become increasingly unwilling to take the "stronger and cheaper" story at face value.
我现在更倾向于把它看作 IPO 窗口前的一场价格竞争：一边用降价争夺用户、展示增: I am now more inclined to see this as price competition ahead of an IPO: cutting prices to win users and demonstrate growth while still dealing with expensive compute capacity and service delivery problems. That is my interpretation; I do not have access to Anthropic's internal decision-making documents. I want to know how much of the engineering economics behind these cuts has been explained, and how much of the growth investors welcome will translate into benefits for users.
Anthropic 在 2026 年 9 月 22 日的发布说明中，将 Opus: In its September 22, 2026 announcement, Anthropic presented Opus 5.5 as a more capable model with lower operating costs. Its claim of a 40% cost reduction on typical workloads compares it with
，条件是其测试中的默认设置；这不等于比所有竞争模型便宜 40%。: , under the default settings in Anthropic's tests. It does not mean the model is 40% cheaper than every competitor.
官方文档确认，每百万 Token 的普通输入价从 5 美元降到 4 美元，输出从: The official documentation confirms that standard input pricing fell from $5 to $4 per million tokens and output pricing from $25 to $20, both reductions of 20%. Cache reads fell from $0.50 to $0.20, a 60% reduction. For Opus 5.5, cache writes cost $5 per million tokens with a five-minute TTL and $8 with a one-hour TTL.
所以，40% 不是一张价格表上可以直接读出的统一折扣。它混合了不同 Token: The 40% figure is therefore not a uniform discount visible on a price list. It combines lower prices for different token categories with changes in consumption on particular tasks. Change the cache mix, reasoning effort, or task, and that percentage can change too.
官方原文写出了对照对象和测试条件；我批评的是这套产品叙事的吸引力：上一代是价格基: The announcement does state its comparison baseline and test conditions. My criticism concerns the appeal of the product narrative: the previous generation supplies the price baseline, favourable tasks supply the capability baseline, and together they make "stronger and cheaper" an easy reason to buy. That still does not tell me whether Opus 5.5 is worth its price alongside the alternatives available today.
我的统计里，最容易被忽略的是缓存: The overlooked part of my usage figures: caching

Codex, using several GPT models, accounted for 4,612 requests, approximately 623 million tokens, and $168.75. Looking only at the totals, I would have thought I was using Codex far more. The Codex totals include other GPT models, so the table does not represent GPT-6.1 Sol alone. Effort settings with the same name across providers do not imply the same compute budget.

但请求不是任务。一次工具调用可能产生请求，一项工作可能拆成很多请求；Claude: A request is not a task, however. A tool call can generate requests, and a single piece of work can involve many requests. Claude Code and Codex use different tool orchestration and context management, and my Codex usage spans several models. 这组个人记录没有统一任务、验收结果和返工时间，却清楚显示了我的使用组合如何消耗资: My personal records do not hold tasks, acceptance criteria, or time spent on rework constant. They do show how my usage setups consume resources, which gives me reason to investigate further. Consumers are entitled to judge a product against their own work rather than remain confined to the success stories a vendor selects.
命中缓存 98.8%，为什么还有这么多费用？: A 98.8% cache hit rate, yet substantial costs
Claude 的统计显示，缓存命中率为 98.8%，其中缓存读取约 355M、写: The Claude statistics show a cache hit rate of 98.8%, approximately 355 million cache-read tokens, 4.46 million cache-write tokens, and 1.27 million output tokens. Newly added standard input is shown as just 2,682 tokens; the reason for this anomaly remains unconfirmed.
按已核实的价格、并将写入统一按五分钟档位估算：缓存读取约 71 美元，输出 25: Using the verified prices and assuming all cache writes use the five-minute rate gives approximately $71 for cache reads, $25.40 for output, $22.30 for cache writes, and $0.01 for standard input: about $118.71 in total. That differs by roughly $0.13 from the $118.58 reported by the software. Rounded usage figures could contribute to the difference; details such as the cache-write TTL would require the underlying logs to confirm.
Claude 等效成本构成，按五分钟缓存写入费率重算: Claude's estimated cost breakdown, recalculated at the five-minute cache-write rate
355M 缓存读取约占显示总 Token 的 98.6%，却仍占重算费用的约 5: The 355 million cache-read tokens account for about 98.6% of the displayed total token count, but still about 59.8% of the recalculated cost. The first percentage comes from dividing the displayed aggregate figures; it should not be confused with the software's reported 98.8% cache hit rate.
缓存命中意味着复用已经处理过的内容，通常省去了重复处理的一部分开销。它有折扣，也: A cache hit reuses content that has already been processed, usually avoiding some of the overhead of processing it again. It receives a discount and is still billed. Even a very low cache-read price can become a major cost when multiplied by enough repeated usage.
再把这组用量固定，按 Opus 5 的旧费率重算，费用约为 237.14 美元；: Holding this usage mix fixed and applying the old Opus 5 rates produces an estimated cost of $237.14. At Opus 5.5 rates, it is approximately $118.71, nearly half as much. Lower cache-read pricing alone accounts for about $106.50 of savings, roughly 90% of the total savings in this fixed-usage calculation.
这笔账说明，对我这种缓存占比极高的组合，降价确实有分量。它也把“降价”的结构说清: For a setup as cache-heavy as mine, that is a meaningful price cut. It also shows where the savings come from: most are due to a lower charge for repeatedly reading context. This calculation holds token usage constant; it does not measure how much each model generation consumes to complete the same task. My records therefore neither verify nor disprove Anthropic's claimed 40% reduction on typical workloads. The savings achieved here and the cost relative to competitors are separate questions.
我在两套工具里看到的差异，也集中在这里：Claude 平均每请求读取约 28.0: The difference between my two tool setups is concentrated here too. Claude reads approximately 280,900 cached tokens per request, compared with about 130,100 for Codex; output averages approximately 1,005 and 449 tokens, respectively. The context repeatedly carried forward is far larger than the final output. Discussing agent costs only in terms of how much text appears in the answer misses a great deal of repeatedly read history.
平均每请求缓存读取与输出 Token，分面显示: Average cache-read and output tokens per request, shown in separate panels
高缓存命中率无法单独证明整套工作流程高效。哪些历史必须保留，哪些调用值得发生，最: A high cache hit rate alone does not establish that the entire workflow is efficient. Whether these costs are worthwhile depends on which history must be retained, which calls are useful, and how much acceptable work is ultimately delivered.
而对订阅用户，API 等效费用和套餐额度之间也没有一张已经公开、可供我逐项复算的: For subscribers, I also lack a publicly available fixed conversion table that would let me reconcile API-equivalent costs with plan allowances item by item. The $118.58 figure cannot tell me directly how quickly I would hit a usage limit. I want to know whether the same subscription tier can reliably support more work, or whether I need to pause, wait, or buy additional usage. These records do not capture those outcomes. They provide leads to investigate, rather than a controlled comparison of subscription value.

在这两项配置之间，Opus 得分领先，测试费用也更高。能力增益值不值差价，要看它: Between these two configurations, Opus achieves a higher score at a higher test cost. Whether the capability gain is worth the difference depends on the problem it solves. An index score of 58 rather than 53 does not mean a productivity gain of about 9%; dividing scores cannot reveal the benefit to my work.
AA 测试的是 Max 配置，与我的日常档位不同；Opus 这一行还带有 fal: AA tests the Max configurations, which differ from my everyday settings. The Opus entry also includes fallback. Those conditions belong alongside the figures.

这些倍数衡量的是图中的计费 Token 消耗，并非算力或浪费程度。但当较低单价被: These ratios describe the billed token consumption in the chart, not compute usage or the amount wasted. 还要正视一组与上述结果方向不同的材料：Anthropic 在同一发布页中，声称: There is also evidence pointing in the other direction. This is a different test from AA's Max composite index, with different benchmarks, effort settings, and workflows. Cost advantages can reverse across tasks and configurations, and selecting one favourable chart can tell a very different product story. I want to know where my typical work falls.
罗福莉这段话，让我更想追问 Anthropic 的工程账: Fuli Luo's post makes me question Anthropic's engineering economics
罗福莉关于 MiMo API 降价的帖文，是我不想漏掉的一块材料。下面的 X 中: Fuli Luo's post about MiMo API price cuts is a piece of evidence I did not want to leave out. The Chinese X translation shown below matches the corresponding English archive. She attributes the largest cut, up to 99%, to cached input, saying that hierarchical KV-cache optimisation in the inference framework increased cache capacity roughly fivefold, equivalent to an approximately 80% reduction in caching costs. She also refers to roughly "2–3 times" of profit headroom in the original pricing and says the new prices can broadly break even when the system runs near full capacity.
罗福莉关于 MiMo API 降价的 X 中文译文截图，界面标注翻译自英语: Fuli Luo's X post on MiMo API price cuts, shown in a Chinese translation from English
这段话的价值，在于把降价放回了工程和商业的关系里：缓存如何变便宜，原先定价留了多: The value of this explanation is that it connects engineering with commercial pricing: how caching became cheaper, how much headroom the original prices left, and why the company is now willing to pass it on. These remain the team leader's own claims, not audited findings, but they at least identify mechanisms that can be examined.
小米技术文章进一步解释，Hybrid SWA 可将 KVCache 存储降至全注: Xiaomi's technical article explains further that Hybrid SWA can reduce KVCache storage to about one-seventh of a full-attention architecture. Cache management, prefix matching, and scheduling must be adapted together to realise those architectural gains. DeepSeek's earlier V3/R1 system overview also discusses prefill/decode disaggregation, expert parallelism, and load balancing. Gains in individual components do not equal a reduction in the cost of the whole service, but they give the discussion something concrete to examine.
回头看 Anthropic，缓存读取报价降低 60%，并不是 KVCache 的: For Anthropic, a 60% cut in the cache-read price is not evidence that KVCache resource costs also fell by 60%. The Opus 5.5 launch and migration documents I read state that the model requires less compute to serve, but do not provide a before-and-after engineering breakdown sufficient for me to verify the change in unit caching costs. That gap does not establish that no optimisation took place. Nor does a lower selling price, by itself, establish an engineering breakthrough.
所以我引入罗福莉，并不是想给另一家公司做广告。我想问 Anthropic：这次降: I am not bringing in Fuli Luo to promote another company. I want to ask Anthropic how much of this price cut comes from engineering savings already achieved, and how much comes from giving up pricing headroom to win market share. The latter is a normal commercial choice too. Consumers need not automatically treat it as a technological dividend, or place their trust in a new price list.
算力可以向马斯克买，稳定交付不能靠发布会代替: Compute can be bought from Musk; press conferences cannot deliver a reliable service
所谓“向马斯克借算力”，准确说是算力采购合作。Anthropic 在 5 月 6: The phrase "borrowing compute from Musk" is more accurately described as a commercial capacity agreement. On May 6, Anthropic announced that it would use all the compute capacity at SpaceX's Colossus 1, gaining access to more than 300 megawatts and over 220,000 NVIDIA GPUs. It linked that expansion directly to higher Claude usage limits. Its partner issued a corresponding announcement.
采购外部算力本身谈不上丢人。但这说明，服务能给用户多少容量，仍与外部供给密切相关: There is nothing shameful about buying external compute capacity. It does show that the capacity available to users remains closely tied to external supply. Buying more compute and using each unit more efficiently are different things. An expansion announcement cannot substitute for evidence of efficiency.
我对 Anthropic 服务工程能力的评价，也没有对它的模型能力那么高。按官方: I do not rate Anthropic's service engineering as highly as its model capabilities. Using the UTC dates on its official status page, elevated errors on September 29 affected the website, Claude Code, Cowork, and the API. Opus 5.5 experienced elevated errors again on October 6. On October 7, some organisations were incorrectly paused for reaching their spending limits, causing requests to the API and other products to be refused. Users bear the consequences of these delivery failures.
Claude 官方状态页过去 90 天快照：API 标注 99.59% 可用率，: Claude's official 90-day status snapshot: 99.59% API uptime, with the service Operational when captured
这张官方状态页快照也保留了多个产品的异常记录，API 标注的过去 90 天可用率: This official status-page snapshot also records service incidents across several products and shows 99.59% API uptime over the past 90 days. It is not an industry-wide comparison, and it does not establish that every incident resulted from insufficient compute. Console reporting failures should not all be counted as inference API outages either. These delivery records are nevertheless enough for me to withhold a high rating for the company's engineering based on model scores alone.
模型能在测试中解出难题，和付费服务能稳定接住需求，是两种能力。对一家公司而言，前: Solving difficult benchmark problems and reliably meeting demand for a paid service are different capabilities. A company can promote the first while being held to account for the second. Slightly cheaper tokens do not compensate for the time lost when errors and interruptions break up a piece of work.
IPO 前的降价，我更愿意按价格战理解: I see the pre-IPO cuts as price competition
这也是我对“更强又更便宜”保持警惕的商业背景。路透社根据看到的招股材料报道，An: This commercial context is another reason I am wary of the "stronger and cheaper" story. Reuters, reporting on a prospectus it had reviewed, said Anthropic recorded nearly $4.6 billion in revenue and more than $8 billion in operating losses in 2025, alongside substantial compute commitments. Its report also placed the Opus 5.5 launch in the context of competition with GPT-6 Astra and the expected IPO.
到 10 月，路透社又援引投资者活动参与者称，公司第三季度收入达到 168 亿美: In October, Reuters cited participants at an investor event as saying that third-quarter revenue reached $16.8 billion and that Anthropic told investors it was profitable for the quarter on an adjusted basis. The previous year's losses, adjusted profitability, and future spending commitments should be read separately.
放在这个时间窗口里，我更愿意把降价理解为争夺市场和维护增长预期的商业动作。更低的: In this window, I am more inclined to interpret the price cuts as a commercial move to win market share and sustain growth expectations. Lower prices may attract more requests and customers, making the story of strong demand, expanding scale, and improving efficiency easier to sell to investors. There are commercial reasons for such a cut even without first establishing a comprehensive infrastructure breakthrough.
这正是我想指责的地方：用户为什么要替企业把价格竞争自动解释成技术胜利，再把尚未兑: That is my criticism: why should users automatically turn a company's price competition into a technological victory, then count economies of scale that have not yet materialised as benefits already received? I have no evidence that Anthropic is dumping services below cost or deliberately deceiving customers, or that it will necessarily cut allowances later. I can still refuse to let this growth narrative serve as an endorsement of its service and pricing.
Opus 5.5 的单价确实降了，我这组用量按新费率也确实便宜了。问题在于，降价: Opus 5.5's unit prices have fallen, and my usage mix is cheaper at the new rates. But the comparison baseline is Anthropic's own old pricing. Competitors' token consumption, users' task costs, and actual service reliability still need to be accounted for.
我仍然承认 Claude 的模型能力，也仍愿意为真正好用的产品付钱。但面对这次降: I still recognise Claude's model capabilities and am willing to pay for a useful product. My response to this price cut is simply not to declare a win for users too soon. The company needs to compete on price and sell a convincing IPO story; I need a tool that reliably finishes the work. There is no reason to assume those interests are the same.
